correctness.rationale: All Grassmannian points are covered by allowed pair charts. On an A--B chart, nonbasis Pluecker vanishing forces A columns on one row, B on other, and rank-one C block. The prime ideal of 2x2 minors gives a genuine affine scheme product; the rank-one locus is smooth away from zero and singular at zero iff c>=2. The three support strata are mutually disjoint. The degree-d Segre cone Hilbert function is (d+1)binom(d+c-1,c-1) and Hilbert series (1+(c-1)t)/(1-t)^(c+1), giving multiplicity c, with a+b-2 smooth dimensions. The symbolic checker confirms finite examples but does not establish the universal quantifier.

value.rationale: The motivating toric positroid classification does not answer local geometry. The natural rank-two three-class family has a complete and nontrivial stratification into potentially positive-dimensional disjoint Segre singular components, distinct transverse determinantal types, and precise unbounded multiplicities governed by omitted class size. These local analytic invariants cannot be read from known yes/no smoothness or Gorenstein tests alone and are a motivated foundation for resolution/intersection-theoretic study.
